Direction A — Operator's manual (built)
Two inks on paper: ink for text and rules, the mark's terracotta for callouts and every "what to do". A running margin column for section numbers and cross-references, numbered figures, ruled entries. No cards, no gradients, no shadows.
This is what lives on the site-redesign branch; the phone layout and one guide page are beside it.
Two low-fi alternates, not built. Each has a case for it and a tradeoff. Say the word and one of them becomes the deliverable instead.
